name: ModeHud
_doc: The game modes' top bar (src/client/ModeHud; Rules/ModeHud, Config/ModeHud; user 2026-10-29, option B of the mode HUD drafts, the front bar: "use the basic font ... remove the capturing bar completely. just make the diamond on the top show the progress"). FrontBar, Territory Push (src/server/Frontline): the viewer's own nation on the left (flag and name; the enemy's is not shown, user 2026-10-30), one diamond per sector joined by a thin line (user 2026-10-29: "remove the bar, just connect them with a line to each diamond. we dont need a progress bar, just the progress diamonds"; Line runs from the first diamond to the last) (Pin, PinHQ for the HQs: the code clones them per sector, evenly spaced, with a PinLabel under each). A diamond fills from its bottom tip in the colour of the side its control leans to, as far as the control goes (the flag's height on the pole); its edge turns pinContested on even numbers in the zone, pinAttacked when its holder is outnumbered there. Result: the winner during the results. FrontBar shows on the loadout screen, and in play only while M is held, fading fast (fade: a CanvasGroup), with a dot over each teammate and a diamond over each point that can be taken now (src/client/ModeHud markers; user 2026-10-30: "show where the point is when you hold v ... the same diamond that shows the same progression as the top bar", "only show the ones that arent locked"), all seen through walls ("make the bar appear and a dot above all teammates ... when players hold v"). Nothing shows on the title screen ("dont show the status of the game until players are on or past the loadout screen"). ZoneBar, Point Capture (FFA, src/server/ZoneMatch; user 2026-10-29: "center the timer and remove the bar completely"): the match clock centred, the point leader under it ("remove the top score and your score. just keep track of the score leader and display it"; the leader's glow is the server's), the zone's state, then the move warning. WaveBar, Territory Push while the viewer's soldier stands frozen in its wave line (src/server/Frontline's WaveHold): the seconds until the wave goes, centred like the FFA clock (user 2026-11-01: players who deploy "have no idea when the countdown ends"). No panels. Sizes in reference pixels at theme.scale.referenceHeight, one UIScale. Colours: Config/Palette UI.Hud names. One font, the game's basic font. Desktop only.
